title: Rav Dimi bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.13): “Rav Zevid — and some say Rav Dimi bar Abba — said: the dispute concerns one who forgot; if deliberately, all agree that he must return to his place and bless.” Hyman gives Rav Dimi’s statement in [Avodah Zarah 15b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.15b.13-14) as follows: “Just as it is forbidden to sell to a gentile, so it is forbidden to sell to an Israelite suspected of selling to a gentile.”[^1]

notes.text: Berakhot gives Rav Zevid and Rav Dimi as alternative speakers. The linked Avodah Zarah passage discusses selling weapons to a Jewish bandit. Hyman’s wording refers instead to a Jew suspected of reselling to a gentile. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=924&lang=en) cites both folios.
